summary: Permanently removes the mailbox with the given `name` from the IMAP server
description:
The .deleteBox() function permanently removes the mailbox with the given name from the IMAP server. Attempting to delete an INBOX or a mailbox that does not exist will generate an error.

In the name parameter, pass the name of the mailbox to delete.

The function cannot delete a mailbox that has child mailboxes if the parent mailbox has the "\Noselect" attribute. All messages in the deleted mailbox will also be deleted. The ability to delete a mailbox depends on the mail server.

Returned object

The function returns an object describing the IMAP status:

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the mailbox to delete
